questions.stem: Which service helps data scientists and developers build, train and deploy machine learning models?

options.rationale: Lex builds chatbots and other conversational interfaces.
SageMaker AI provides tools to build, train and deploy your own ML models.
Rekognition is a ready-made service for image and video analysis.
Elastic Beanstalk deploys and scales web applications, not ML models.

questions.explanation: The clue is building and training your own models: SageMaker AI is the ML platform, while Lex and Rekognition are ready-made AI services you use without training a model.

questions.stem: Which service builds conversational interfaces, such as chatbots, that understand voice and text?

options.rationale: Polly turns text into lifelike speech but does not understand what users say.
SageMaker AI is for building custom ML models.
Lex provides speech recognition and language understanding for chatbots.
Athena queries data in S3.

questions.explanation: The clue is a chatbot that understands voice and text: Lex handles the conversation, while Polly only speaks text aloud.

questions.stem: Which service identifies objects, people and text in images and videos?

options.rationale: Rekognition offers ready-made image and video analysis.
Polly turns text into lifelike speech.
Transcribe converts speech to text.
SageMaker AI is for building and training your own ML models.

questions.explanation: The clue is analyzing images and video with a ready-made service: Rekognition does this without training a model, while SageMaker AI is for building your own models.

questions.stem: Which service turns text into lifelike speech?

options.rationale: Transcribe does the reverse: speech to text.
Polly is a text-to-speech service.
Rekognition analyzes images and video.
Lex builds chatbots that understand language.

questions.explanation: Polly speaks text; Transcribe writes down speech.

questions.stem: A company wants to convert recordings of customer phone calls into text. Which service should it use?

options.rationale: Polly converts text into speech.
Rekognition analyzes images and video.
Transcribe uses automatic speech recognition to convert speech to text.
Comprehend finds meaning in text that already exists; it does not turn audio into text.

questions.explanation: The clue is turning speech into text: Transcribe does that, while Polly goes the other way and turns text into speech.

questions.stem: Which service lets analysts run SQL queries directly on data stored in Amazon S3 without loading it into a database?

options.rationale: Kinesis processes streaming data.
Glue catalogs and transforms data; Athena can then query it.
Amazon Quick is an AI-powered service whose features include business intelligence dashboards.
Athena is a serverless, interactive query service for data in S3.

questions.explanation: The clue is SQL directly on S3 with nothing to load: Athena is a serverless query service, while Glue prepares and catalogs the data that Athena queries.

questions.stem: Which service collects and processes streaming data, such as website clickstreams, in real time?

options.rationale: Kinesis captures, processes and analyzes real-time streaming data.
Athena queries data at rest in S3.
Glue runs data preparation and ETL jobs.
Redshift is a cloud data warehouse for analyzing stored data.

questions.explanation: Kinesis is for data in motion; Athena is for data at rest in S3.

questions.stem: Which serverless service discovers, prepares and combines data for analytics, including extract, transform and load (ETL) jobs?

options.rationale: Kinesis handles streaming data.
Glue is a serverless data integration service with a data catalog and ETL.
Athena queries data; it does not run ETL pipelines.
Lex builds chatbots.

questions.explanation: The Glue Data Catalog is often the metadata store that Athena queries use.

questions.stem: Which service creates interactive dashboards and business intelligence visualizations?

options.rationale: Athena runs queries but does not build dashboards.
Glue prepares data.
Amazon Quick is an AI-powered service that includes business intelligence: interactive dashboards and visualizations.
SageMaker AI builds ML models.

questions.explanation: The clue is dashboards for business users: Amazon Quick visualizes data, while Athena runs the queries that can feed those dashboards.

questions.stem: Which TWO are analytics services? (Choose TWO.)

options.rationale: Lex is an AI service for chatbots.
Rekognition is an AI service for image analysis.
Amazon Quick analyzes data and provides business intelligence dashboards.
Polly is an AI service for text to speech.
Athena queries data in S3 with SQL.

questions.explanation: Analytics services query, process or visualize data, such as Athena, Kinesis, Glue, Amazon Quick, Redshift and EMR; Lex, Rekognition and Polly are AI services that perform a single task.

questions.stem: Which service uses natural language processing to find sentiment, key phrases and entities in text?

options.rationale: Polly turns text into speech.
Comprehend extracts insights such as sentiment and entities from text.
Rekognition analyzes images and video.
Textract extracts text from documents.

questions.explanation: Comprehend is used for tasks such as analyzing customer reviews.

questions.stem: Which service extracts printed text, handwriting and data such as tables and forms from scanned documents?

options.rationale: Comprehend analyzes the meaning of text.
Translate converts text between languages.
Textract goes beyond simple OCR to pull structured data from documents.
Transcribe converts speech to text.

questions.explanation: The clue is scanned documents with forms and tables: Textract pulls text and structured data out of documents, while Comprehend analyzes the meaning of text that already exists.

questions.stem: Which service translates text from one language to another?

options.rationale: Transcribe converts speech to text.
Polly turns text into speech.
Lex builds chatbots.
Translate uses machine learning to translate text between languages on demand.

questions.explanation: The clue is changing text from one language to another: Translate does that, while Transcribe turns speech into text and Polly turns text into speech.

questions.stem: A developer wants a generative AI assistant in the code editor (IDE) that answers questions about AWS and suggests code. Which service should the developer use?

options.rationale: Lex is for building your own chatbots, not a ready-made assistant for AWS work.
Bedrock gives access to foundation models for building your own generative AI applications; it is not a ready-made assistant for AWS work.
Amazon Q Developer is a generative AI-powered assistant that answers questions about AWS and generates code in the IDE and on the command line.
SageMaker AI is for building, training and deploying your own ML models.

questions.explanation: The clue is a ready-made generative AI assistant for AWS work: Amazon Q Developer answers questions and writes code, while Lex and Bedrock are services for building chatbots or generative AI applications of your own.

questions.stem: A company wants to add generative AI features to its application by calling foundation models from leading AI companies through an API. It does not want to train a model or manage infrastructure. Which service should it use?

options.rationale: SageMaker AI provides tools and managed infrastructure to build, train and deploy your own ML models.
Amazon Q is a ready-made generative AI assistant, not a service for building your own applications on foundation models.
Bedrock is a fully managed, serverless service that offers foundation models through a single API for building generative AI applications.
Lex builds chatbots and other conversational interfaces that use voice and text.

questions.explanation: The clue is calling existing foundation models through an API with no training or infrastructure: Bedrock offers foundation models as a serverless service, while SageMaker AI is where you build, train and deploy your own models.

questions.stem: Which statement correctly describes how Amazon SageMaker AI differs from Amazon Bedrock?

options.text: SageMaker AI requires no model training or deployment work
options.rationale: That describes Bedrock more closely: Bedrock is serverless and offers foundation models through a single API, while SageMaker AI is where you build, train and deploy models.

options.text: SageMaker AI is a generative AI assistant for answering AWS questions
options.rationale: A ready-made generative AI assistant for AWS questions describes Amazon Q.

options.text: SageMaker AI is a business intelligence service for building dashboards
options.rationale: Business intelligence dashboards describe Amazon Quick.

options.text: SageMaker AI is for building and training your own models
options.rationale: SageMaker AI provides tools and managed infrastructure to build, train and deploy your own ML models, while Bedrock offers ready-made foundation models through an API.

questions.explanation: The clue is your own models: SageMaker AI is the platform to build, train and deploy ML models, while Bedrock is a serverless way to use existing foundation models through an API.
